<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Escala de Turno · ZAMine</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Escala de turno 12 h (07–19 / 19–07), 4 turmas em 4x4. Edite TURMAS e INICIO_CICLO no fim do arquivo. Fundo branco: class="zm-esc claro" */
.zm-esc{--bg:#0d0c0b;--panel:#181614;--panel2:#211e1b;--line:#2e2a26;--fg:#f5f2ee;--muted:#a39b92;--accent:#ff6600;--on:#140900;
  --A:#ff8a3d;--B:#4fb6f0;--C:#5fd27a;--D:#f2c230;--dia:#ffd27a;--noite:#8fa4ff;
  font-family:"Barlow","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:100vh;
  padding:clamp(20px,3vw,44px) max(16px,3vw)}
.zm-esc.claro{--bg:#f6f4f1;--panel:#fff;--panel2:#ebe6e0;--line:#dcd4cb;--fg:#17130f;--muted:#5f574f;--accent:#f26100;--on:#fff;
  --A:#e06a12;--B:#0b7fbf;--C:#25913e;--D:#a87d00;--dia:#b98200;--noite:#4a5fd0}
.zm-esc *{box-sizing:border-box}
.zm-esc button,.zm-esc select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.zm-esc .num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.zm-esc .hd{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:clamp(14px,2vw,22px);border-bottom:3px solid var(--accent)}
.zm-esc .hd small{display:block;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,14px)}
.zm-esc .hd h1{margin:6px 0 0;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.9;font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,76px);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.zm-esc .hd h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.zm-esc .hd .r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.zm-esc .clk{text-align:right}
.zm-esc .clk b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(36px,4vw,64px);font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.zm-esc .clk span{color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,17px);text-transform:capitalize}
.zm-esc .logo{height:clamp(40px,4.4vw,64px);width:auto;display:block}
.zm-esc .logo-l{display:none}.zm-esc.claro .logo-d{display:none}.zm-esc.claro .logo-l{display:block}

/* agora */
.zm-esc .now{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,20px);margin-top:clamp(16px,2.2vw,28px)}
.zm-esc .card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}
.zm-esc .ag{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(16px,2vw,28px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(18px,2vw,28px);border:2px solid var(--c);overflow:hidden}
.zm-esc .ag::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--c);opacity:.08;pointer-events:none}
.zm-esc .ph{position:relative;width:clamp(110px,11vw,170px);aspect-ratio:1}
.zm-esc .ph .av{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:5px solid var(--c);background:var(--panel2);display:grid;place-items:center}
.zm-esc .av img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.zm-esc .av span{font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:44px;color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .ph .lt{position:absolute;right:-6px;bottom:-6px;width:clamp(46px,4.4vw,64px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);color:var(--on);display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8vw,40px);border:4px solid var(--panel)}
.zm-esc .ag .tx{position:relative;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.zm-esc .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}
.zm-esc .live::before{content:"";width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);animation:zmPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes zmPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(1.4)}}
.zm-esc .ag b.nm{font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(36px,4.2vw,68px);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.92}
.zm-esc .ag .sh{font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,21px);font-weight:600}
.zm-esc .ag .sh i{font-style:normal;color:var(--sc)}
.zm-esc .tl{height:8px;background:var(--panel2);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
.zm-esc .tl i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--c)}
.zm-esc .ag small{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.zm-esc .mini{padding:clamp(16px,1.8vw,24px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;border-left:6px solid var(--c)}
.zm-esc .mini .av{width:clamp(64px,6vw,88px);height:clamp(64px,6vw,88px);border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--c);background:var(--panel2);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.zm-esc .mini .av span{font-size:26px}
.zm-esc .mini div{min-width:0}
.zm-esc .mini small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .mini b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(24px,2.2vw,34px);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;margin:4px 0}
.zm-esc .mini span.s{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

/* barra */
.zm-esc .bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px) 0 12px}
.zm-esc .bar h2{margin:0 auto 0 0;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,36px);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.zm-esc .btn{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;line-height:1}
.zm-esc .btn:hover{border-color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .btn.ic{width:42px;padding:10px 0;text-align:center}
.zm-esc .btn.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.zm-esc .leg{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:12px}
.zm-esc .leg span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}

/* grade por turma */
.zm-esc .gw{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow-x:auto}
.zm-esc table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;min-width:980px;table-layout:fixed}
.zm-esc col.c0{width:210px}
.zm-esc th,.zm-esc td{text-align:center;padding:0}
.zm-esc thead th{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);padding:10px 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.zm-esc thead th b{display:block;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--fg);line-height:1}
.zm-esc thead th.fds b{color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc th.hj{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
.zm-esc th.hj b{color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc tbody th{text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;left:0;background:var(--panel);z-index:1;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.zm-esc .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.zm-esc .who .lt2{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);color:var(--on);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;flex:none}
.zm-esc .who b{font-size:16px;display:block}
.zm-esc .who small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.zm-esc tbody td{padding:5px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.zm-esc tbody tr:last-child td,.zm-esc tbody tr:last-child th{border-bottom:0}
.zm-esc td.hj{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent)}
.zm-esc .cl{display:grid;place-items:center;height:38px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
.zm-esc .cl.kd{background:var(--c);color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc .cl.kn{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 30%,var(--panel2));color:var(--fg);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--c)}
.zm-esc .cl.kf{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;opacity:.5}
.zm-esc .cl.agora{outline:3px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:1px}
.zm-esc .ic-d,.zm-esc .ic-n{width:14px;height:14px;display:inline-block;border-radius:3px}
.zm-esc .ic-d{background:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .ic-n{background:var(--panel2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--muted)}

/* calendário */
.zm-esc .cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}
.zm-esc .dw{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:4px 0}
.zm-esc .dd{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0}
.zm-esc .dd.vz{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
.zm-esc .dd.hj{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent)}
.zm-esc .dd>b{font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.zm-esc .dd.hj>b{color:var(--accent)}
.zm-esc .sl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:0}
.zm-esc .sl.kd{background:var(--c);color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc .sl.kn{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 22%,var(--panel2));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--c)}
.zm-esc .sl span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600}
.zm-esc .sl.agora{outline:2px solid var(--fg)}
.zm-esc .A{--c:var(--A)}.zm-esc .B{--c:var(--B)}.zm-esc .C{--c:var(--C)}.zm-esc .D{--c:var(--D)}
@media (max-width:980px){ .zm-esc .now{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .zm-esc .ag{grid-column:1/-1} }
@media (max-width:560px){ .zm-esc .now{grid-template-columns:1fr} .zm-esc .sl span{display:none} .zm-esc .dd{padding:5px} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .zm-esc .live::before{animation:none} }
.zm-esc .ico{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:1.1em;height:1.1em;vertical-align:-0.15em;margin-right:4px;font-style:normal}
.zm-esc .ico svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.zm-esc .ico.sol{color:var(--dia)}.zm-esc .ico.lua{color:var(--noite)}
.zm-esc .cl svg{width:20px;height:20px;display:block}
.zm-esc .cl.kd{color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc .cl.kn{color:var(--c)}
.zm-esc .cl.kev{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--panel2) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.zm-esc .sw{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;background:var(--c)}
.zm-esc .sw.ev{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--muted) 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .tg{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.zm-esc .tg.on{background:var(--c);border-color:var(--c);color:var(--on)}
.zm-esc tr.cur th{box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--c)}
.zm-esc .hm{display:flex;gap:clamp(16px,2vw,32px);margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.zm-esc .hm span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .hm b{font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(26px,2.4vw,38px);font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.zm-esc .hm em{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);font-size:.7em}
.zm-esc .tl.thin{height:5px;margin-top:6px}
.zm-esc .tl.thin i{background:var(--fg);opacity:.6}
.zm-esc .evt{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.zm-esc .sl .ico{width:14px;height:14px;margin-right:2px}
.zm-esc .sl.kd .ico{color:var(--on)}.zm-esc .sl.kn .ico{color:var(--c)}
.zm-esc .sl.sev{opacity:.75;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--panel2) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px)!important;color:var(--muted)}
.zm-esc .mini .s.num{display:block;margin-top:2px}
.zm-esc .who{min-width:0}
.zm-esc col.c0{width:250px}

/* ===== cabe numa tela só ===== */
html,body{height:100%}
.zm-esc{height:100vh;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(12px,2.2vh,28px) max(16px,2vw)}
.zm-esc .hd{padding-bottom:clamp(8px,1.2vh,14px);border-bottom-width:3px;flex:none}
.zm-esc .hd small{font-size:clamp(10px,1.2vh,13px)}
.zm-esc .hd h1{font-size:clamp(28px,5.4vh,58px);margin-top:2px}
.zm-esc .clk b{font-size:clamp(28px,4.8vh,52px)}
.zm-esc .clk span{font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vh,15px)}
.zm-esc .logo{height:clamp(32px,5.4vh,56px)}
.zm-esc .now{flex:none;margin-top:clamp(10px,1.6vh,20px);gap:clamp(10px,1.2vw,16px)}
.zm-esc .ag{padding:clamp(12px,1.8vh,22px) clamp(14px,1.4vw,22px);gap:clamp(14px,1.4vw,22px)}
.zm-esc .ph{width:clamp(80px,14vh,140px)}
.zm-esc .ph .lt{width:clamp(34px,5.4vh,52px);font-size:clamp(20px,3.4vh,32px);border-width:3px}
.zm-esc .ag b.nm{font-size:clamp(28px,5.6vh,56px)}
.zm-esc .ag .sh{font-size:clamp(13px,1.9vh,18px)}
.zm-esc .ag small{font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vh,14px)}
.zm-esc .tl{margin-top:5px;height:6px}
.zm-esc .hm{margin-top:6px}
.zm-esc .hm b{font-size:clamp(20px,3.4vh,32px)}
.zm-esc .hm span{font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vh,11px)}
.zm-esc .mini{padding:clamp(10px,1.6vh,18px) clamp(12px,1.2vw,18px);gap:12px}
.zm-esc .mini .av{width:clamp(48px,8vh,76px);height:clamp(48px,8vh,76px)}
.zm-esc .mini b{font-size:clamp(20px,3.4vh,30px)}
.zm-esc .mini small{font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vh,12px)}
.zm-esc .mini span.s{font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vh,14px)}
.zm-esc .bar{flex:none;margin:clamp(10px,1.6vh,20px) 0 6px}
.zm-esc .bar h2{font-size:clamp(18px,3vh,28px)}
.zm-esc .bar .btn{padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px}
.zm-esc .bar .btn.ic{width:34px;padding:7px 0}
.zm-esc .leg{flex:none;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vh,13px);gap:12px}
#eView{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex}
.zm-esc .gw{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;overflow:auto}
.zm-esc table{min-width:900px;height:100%}
.zm-esc thead th{padding:6px 0 5px;font-size:10px}
.zm-esc thead th b{font-size:clamp(14px,2.2vh,19px)}
.zm-esc tbody th{padding:4px 10px}
.zm-esc tbody td{padding:3px 2px}
.zm-esc .cl{height:auto;min-height:24px;aspect-ratio:auto;height:calc(100% - 2px);max-height:44px}
.zm-esc .cl svg{width:clamp(13px,2.2vh,19px);height:clamp(13px,2.2vh,19px)}
.zm-esc .who .lt2{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:16px}
.zm-esc .who b{font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vh,15px)}
.zm-esc .who small{font-size:clamp(10px,1.4vh,12px)}
.zm-esc col.c0{width:clamp(200px,15vw,240px)}
.zm-esc tbody tr{height:25%}
@media (max-width:980px){ .zm-esc{height:auto;overflow:visible} #eView,.zm-esc .gw{display:block} .zm-esc table{height:auto} .zm-esc .cl{height:34px} }
.zm-esc .who .tg{margin:3px 0 0;display:inline-block;font-size:9px;padding:2px 6px}

/* eventos: cor por tipo; dia que estaria escalado x dia livre dentro do período */
.zm-esc{--fer:#b38cff;--fol:#38c6c6;--out:#a39b92}
.zm-esc.claro{--fer:#7b4fd6;--fol:#108f8f;--out:#6a625a}
.zm-esc .ev-fer{--e:var(--fer)}.zm-esc .ev-fol{--e:var(--fol)}.zm-esc .ev-out{--e:var(--out)}
.zm-esc .cl.kev{color:var(--e);box-shadow:none;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.zm-esc .cl.kev.kfree{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--e) 16%,transparent);height:10px;min-height:10px;align-self:center;border-radius:3px;margin:auto 0}
.zm-esc .cl.kev.kesc{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--e) 38%,transparent) 0 5px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--e) 14%,transparent) 5px 10px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--e);display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-weight:800}
.zm-esc .cl.kev .eico{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;opacity:.9;flex:none}
.zm-esc .cl.kev .eico svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.zm-esc .cl.kev em{font-style:normal;line-height:1;color:var(--fg)}
.zm-esc td{vertical-align:middle}
.zm-esc .sw.evs{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--e) 30%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--e)}
.zm-esc .sw.evx{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--muted) 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0">
<section class="zm-esc" id="zmEsc" aria-labelledby="eT">
  <header class="hd">
    <div><small>ZAMine · Escala de turno 12 h</small><h1 id="eT">Outubro <em>2026</em></h1></div>
    <div class="r"><div class="clk"><b class="num" id="eClk">--:--</b><span id="eDt"></span></div>
      <img class="logo logo-d" alt="ZAMine" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img class="logo logo-l" alt="ZAMine" src="data:image/png;base64,"></div>
  </header>
  <div class="now" id="eNow"></div>
  <div class="bar">
    <h2 id="eH2">Escala do mês</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn ic" id="bPrev" aria-label="Mês anterior">◀</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn" id="bHoje">Mês atual</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn ic" id="bNext" aria-label="Próximo mês">▶</button>
  </div>
  <div class="leg" id="eLeg"></div>
  <div id="eView"></div>
</section>
<script>
/* =====================================================================
   EDITE AQUI
   Ciclo de 8 dias por pessoa: 2 dias, 2 noites e 4 de folga. As turmas
   entram de 2 em 2 dias, na ordem da lista.
   INICIO_CICLO = dia em que a turma A fez o 1º diurno do ciclo.
   ORDEM: D = diurno, N = noturno, F = folga.
   EVENTOS: férias, folga extra, atestado, treinamento... Os turnos dentro
   do período saem das horas esperadas. "cobre" é opcional (quem substitui).
   ===================================================================== */
var INICIO_CICLO = "2026-10-01";
var DIA = {inicio:7, fim:19};
var HORAS_TURNO = 12;
var ORDEM = ["D","D","N","N","F","F","F","F"];
var TURMAS = [{"letra": "A", "nome": "Higor Ataides", "foto": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"letra": "B", "nome": "Marcelo Gonçalves", "foto": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"letra": "C", "nome": "Weslley Ferreira", "foto": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"letra": "D", "nome": "Marcos Paulo", "foto": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}];
var EVENTOS = [
  // {letra:"B", tipo:"Férias", de:"2026-11-10", ate:"2026-11-24", cobre:"Nome de quem cobre"},
];
/* ===================================================================== */
(function(){
  var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);};
  var esc=function(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});};
  var MESES=["Janeiro","Fevereiro","Março","Abril","Maio","Junho","Julho","Agosto","Setembro","Outubro","Novembro","Dezembro"];
  var DS=["Dom","Seg","Ter","Qua","Qui","Sex","Sáb"];
  var SOL='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.6" fill="currentColor"/><g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 2.5v2.6M12 18.9v2.6M2.5 12h2.6M18.9 12h2.6M5.3 5.3l1.8 1.8M16.9 16.9l1.8 1.8M5.3 18.7l1.8-1.8M16.9 7.1l1.8-1.8"/></g></svg>';
  var LUA='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.5 14.6A8.6 8.6 0 0 1 9.4 3.5a8.6 8.6 0 1 0 11.1 11.1z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  var T={}; TURMAS.forEach(function(t,i){T[t.letra]=t; t._i=i;});
  var pD=function(s){ var p=String(s).split("-"); return new Date(+p[0],+p[1]-1,+p[2]); };
  var base=pD(INICIO_CICLO), passo2=ORDEM.length/TURMAS.length;
  var hh=function(h){return ("0"+h).slice(-2)+":00";};
  var dia0=function(d){ return new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()); };
  function cod(L,d){ var n=Math.round((dia0(d)-base)/864e5), p=((n-T[L]._i*passo2)%ORDEM.length+ORDEM.length)%ORDEM.length; return ORDEM[p]; }
  function evento(L,d){ var x=+dia0(d); for(var i=0;i<EVENTOS.length;i++){ var e=EVENTOS[i]; if(e.letra===L && x>=+pD(e.de) && x<=+pD(e.ate)) return e; } return null; }
  function tipoEv(e){ var t=String(e.tipo||"").toLowerCase(); return t.indexOf("féri")===0||t.indexOf("feri")===0?"ev-fer":t.indexOf("folg")===0?"ev-fol":"ev-out"; }
  function escala(d){ var r={dia:"",noite:""}; TURMAS.forEach(function(t){ var c=cod(t.letra,d); if(c==="D") r.dia=t.letra; if(c==="N") r.noite=t.letra; }); return r; }
  function iniT(d,tipo){ return tipo==="D"?new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate(),DIA.inicio):new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate(),DIA.fim); }
  function fimT(d,tipo){ return tipo==="D"?new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate(),DIA.fim):new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()+1,DIA.inicio); }
  /* resumo do mês de uma turma: turnos esperados (sem eventos), feitos, horas */
  function resumo(L,a,m,agora){ var dias=new Date(a,m+1,0).getDate(), tot=0, feitos=0, h=0;
    for(var d=1;d<=dias;d++){ var dt=new Date(a,m,d), c=cod(L,dt); if(c==="F"||evento(L,dt)) continue; tot++;
      var i0=iniT(dt,c), i1=fimT(dt,c); if(agora>=i1){ feitos++; h+=HORAS_TURNO; } else if(agora>i0){ h+=(agora-i0)/36e5; } }
    return {tot:tot,feitos:feitos,h:h,esp:tot*HORAS_TURNO}; }
  function av(L,cls){ var t=T[L]||{}; return '<span class="'+(cls||"av")+'">'+(t.foto?'<img src="'+t.foto+'" alt="">':'<span>'+esc(L)+'</span>')+'</span>'; }
  function turnoAgora(n){ var h=n.getHours()+n.getMinutes()/60, d=dia0(n);
    if(h>=DIA.inicio&&h<DIA.fim) return {tipo:"D",ref:d}; if(h<DIA.inicio) d=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()-1); return {tipo:"N",ref:d}; }
  function seguinte(t){ if(t.tipo==="D") return {tipo:"N",ref:t.ref}; return {tipo:"D",ref:new Date(t.ref.getFullYear(),t.ref.getMonth(),t.ref.getDate()+1)}; }
  function quem(t){ var e=escala(t.ref); return t.tipo==="D"?e.dia:e.noite; }
  /* ordem das linhas: quem está agora, quem vem em seguida, depois os outros pela próxima entrada */
  function ordemTurmas(n){ var t=turnoAgora(n), pos={}, k=0, cur=t;
    for(var i=0;i<ORDEM.length*2 && k<TURMAS.length;i++){ var L=quem(cur); if(L && pos[L]===undefined){ pos[L]=k++; } cur=seguinte(cur); }
    return TURMAS.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (pos[a.letra]===undefined?99:pos[a.letra])-(pos[b.letra]===undefined?99:pos[b.letra]); }); }
  var ano, mes, vis="t";
  function hdr(){ var n=new Date(); $("eClk").textContent=n.toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}); $("eDt").textContent=n.toLocaleDateString("pt-BR",{weekday:"long",day:"2-digit",month:"long"}); }
  var fH=function(x){ return Math.floor(x+1e-9); };
  function vNow(){
    var n=new Date(), t=turnoAgora(n), L=quem(t), tt=T[L]||{nome:"—"}, i0=iniT(t.ref,t.tipo), i1=fimT(t.ref,t.tipo);
    var pc=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(n-i0)/(i1-i0)*100)), rest=Math.max(0,Math.round((i1-n)/6e4)), rh=Math.floor(rest/60), rm=rest%60;
    var ev=evento(L,t.ref), R=resumo(L,n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n);
    var P=seguinte(t), PL=quem(P), pt=T[PL]||{nome:"—"}, pev=evento(PL,P.ref), PR=resumo(PL,n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n);
    var hj=dia0(n), folga=TURMAS.filter(function(x){ return cod(x.letra,hj)==="F"; });
    var nomeAgora = ev ? (ev.cobre?esc(ev.cobre):'Sem substituto') : esc(tt.nome);
    var hpc=R.esp?Math.min(100,R.h/R.esp*100):0;
    $("eNow").innerHTML='<div class="card ag '+L+'"><div class="ph">'+av(L)+'<span class="lt">'+esc(L)+'</span></div><div class="tx"><span class="live">No turno agora</span><b class="nm">'+nomeAgora+'</b>'+
      (ev?'<span class="evt">'+esc(tt.nome)+' em '+esc(ev.tipo.toLowerCase())+'</span>':'')+
      '<span class="sh">Turma '+esc(L)+' · <i class="ico '+(t.tipo==="D"?"sol":"lua")+'">'+(t.tipo==="D"?SOL:LUA)+'</i>'+(t.tipo==="D"?"Diurno":"Noturno")+' · '+hh(t.tipo==="D"?DIA.inicio:DIA.fim)+' às '+hh(t.tipo==="D"?DIA.fim:DIA.inicio)+'</span>'+
      '<div class="tl"><i style="width:'+pc+'%"></i></div><small>Faltam '+(rh?rh+" h ":"")+rm+' min para a troca</small>'+
      '<div class="hm"><div><span>Horas no mês</span><b class="num">'+fH(R.h)+' h <em>/ '+R.esp+' h</em></b></div><div><span>Turnos</span><b class="num">'+("0"+R.feitos).slice(-2)+' <em>/ '+("0"+R.tot).slice(-2)+'</em></b></div></div>'+
      '<div class="tl thin"><i style="width:'+hpc+'%"></i></div></div></div>'+
      '<div class="card mini '+PL+'">'+av(PL)+'<div><small>Próximo turno · '+hh(P.tipo==="D"?DIA.inicio:DIA.fim)+'</small><b>'+(pev?(pev.cobre?esc(pev.cobre):"Sem substituto"):esc(pt.nome))+'</b><span class="s">Turma '+esc(PL)+' · '+(P.tipo==="D"?"Diurno":"Noturno")+(pev?' · '+esc(pt.nome)+' em '+esc(pev.tipo.toLowerCase()):'')+'</span>'+
        '<span class="s num">'+fH(PR.h)+' h / '+PR.esp+' h no mês</span></div></div>'+
      '<div class="card mini" style="--c:var(--line)"><div><small>De folga hoje</small><b>'+folga.map(function(x){return esc(x.nome);}).join(" · ")+'</b><span class="s">Turmas '+folga.map(function(x){return x.letra;}).join(" e ")+'</span></div></div>';
  }
  function vMes(){
    var n=new Date(), hoje=dia0(n), now=turnoAgora(n);
    $("eT").innerHTML=esc(MESES[mes])+' <em>'+ano+'</em>';
    $("eLeg").innerHTML=TURMAS.map(function(t){return '<span class="'+t.letra+'"><i class="sw"></i>'+t.letra+' · '+esc(t.nome)+'</span>';}).join("")+
      '<span><i class="ico sol">'+SOL+'</i>Diurno '+hh(DIA.inicio)+'–'+hh(DIA.fim)+'</span><span><i class="ico lua">'+LUA+'</i>Noturno '+hh(DIA.fim)+'–'+hh(DIA.inicio)+'</span><span class="ev-fer"><i class="sw evs"></i>Férias</span><span class="ev-fol"><i class="sw evs"></i>Folga</span><span class="ev-out"><i class="sw evs"></i>Outro evento</span><span><i class="sw evx"></i>Dia que estaria escalado</span>';
    var dias=new Date(ano,mes+1,0).getDate();
    var ehHj=function(d){ return ano===hoje.getFullYear()&&mes===hoje.getMonth()&&d===hoje.getDate(); };
    var ehNow=function(d,tipo){ return +now.ref===+new Date(ano,mes,d) && now.tipo===tipo; };
    {
      var ord=ordemTurmas(n), cur=quem(now), prx=quem(seguinte(now));
      var h='<div class="gw"><table><colgroup><col class="c0"></colgroup><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left;padding-left:14px">Turma</th>';
      for(var d=1;d<=dias;d++){ var wd=new Date(ano,mes,d).getDay(); h+='<th class="'+(ehHj(d)?"hj":"")+(wd===0||wd===6?" fds":"")+'">'+DS[wd][0]+'<b class="num">'+d+'</b></th>'; }
      h+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
      ord.forEach(function(t){ var R=resumo(t.letra,ano,mes,n), row='';
        for(var d=1;d<=dias;d++){ var dt=new Date(ano,mes,d), k=cod(t.letra,dt), e=evento(t.letra,dt);
          var et = e ? tipoEv(e) : "", esc_ = e && k!=="F";
          var cls = e ? ("kev "+et+(esc_?" kesc":" kfree")) : k==="D"?"kd":k==="N"?"kn":"kf", ag=(!e&&((k==="D"&&ehNow(d,"D"))||(k==="N"&&ehNow(d,"N"))))?" agora":"";
          var ttl = e ? e.tipo+(esc_?" · estaria no "+(k==="D"?"diurno":"noturno"):"")+(e.cobre&&esc_?" · cobre: "+e.cobre:"") : k==="D"?"Diurno":k==="N"?"Noturno":"Folga";
          row+='<td class="'+(ehHj(d)?"hj":"")+'"><span class="cl '+cls+ag+'" title="'+esc(ttl)+'">'+(e?(esc_?'<i class="eico">'+(k==="D"?SOL:LUA)+'</i><em>'+esc(e.tipo.slice(0,3))+'</em>':""):k==="D"?SOL:k==="N"?LUA:"")+'</span></td>'; }
        var tag = t.letra===cur?'<span class="tg on">No turno</span>':t.letra===prx?'<span class="tg">Próximo</span>':'';
        h+='<tr class="'+t.letra+(t.letra===cur?" cur":"")+'"><th><div class="who"><span class="lt2">'+t.letra+'</span><div><b>'+esc(t.nome)+'</b><small class="num">'+("0"+R.feitos).slice(-2)+'/'+("0"+R.tot).slice(-2)+' dias</small>'+tag+'</div></div></th>'+row+'</tr>'; });
      $("eView").innerHTML=h+'</tbody></table></div>';
    }
  }
  function mover(k){ mes+=k; if(mes<0){mes=11;ano--;} if(mes>11){mes=0;ano++;} vMes(); }
  var t0=new Date(); ano=t0.getFullYear(); mes=t0.getMonth();
  $("bPrev").onclick=function(){mover(-1);}; $("bNext").onclick=function(){mover(1);};
  $("bHoje").onclick=function(){ var x=new Date(); ano=x.getFullYear(); mes=x.getMonth(); vMes(); };
  hdr(); vNow(); vMes();
  var chave=function(){ var t=turnoAgora(new Date()); return t.tipo+t.ref.getTime(); }, ultimo=chave();
  setInterval(function(){ hdr(); vNow(); var k=chave(); if(k!==ultimo){ ultimo=k; vMes(); } }, 30000);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
